feeds.title: Watch The Yard
feeds.description: Watch The Yard is a media company revolutionizing the Black college experience. Founded in 2014, Watch The Yard has quickly become a leading destination for Black news, culture, and conversation online. Our interactive, international, and intergenerational community attracts over 1 million people across the African diaspora each month.

feeds.title: coco bassey
feeds.description: I'm a millennial girl in the world who spends most of my days working in the corporate world, and my nights and weekends working on this little project of mine that you're reading right now. I hope this online space offers you a dose of life & style inspiration, so you can join me in my mission of redefining the millennial experience, one outfit at a time. let's do this!

feeds.title: Bianca Dottin Blog
feeds.description: Bianca Dottin, a vibrant lifestyle expert and mama, resides in sunny Orlando, FL. With a degree in Communications from UCF, she's an adventurer passionate about travelling, food, and photography. Through her blog, she inspires moms to embrace motherhood, married life, style, travel, and family recipes, fostering a life they adore, one day at a time.

feeds.title: Mattie James
feeds.description: After style blogging for 7 years, I decided it was time for a change. While blogging about my daily outfits was fun, quite a bit changed over the years. I became a mom, started blogging full time and grew in my faith.

feeds.title: Officially Yasmin
feeds.description: Welcome to my blog. I document my adventures in travel, style, and food.

feeds.title: Karisma Ray
feeds.description: Karisma Ray, an Atlanta-based millennial beauty and lifestyle blogger, invites readers to her blog. Offering lifestyle, beauty, and travel insights, she shares personal adventures and tips. Through her platform, she aims to inspire self-love and confidence, empowering readers to navigate life with positivity and purpose.

feeds.title: Joanna E
feeds.description: Joanna E, an IT professional and award-winning travel blogger, runs a lifestyle platform. She shares travel guides, style tips, and beauty insights, inspiring millennial and professional women to prioritize travel despite their busy lives. With passion, she empowers women of colour to pursue their dreams, whether traditional or not.

feeds.title: Talking With Tami
feeds.description: Tami Reed, with a flair for fashion and sharp wit, shines in celebrity, lifestyle, and fashion circles. Her expertise attracts partnerships with major brands like K-Mart and Disney. As content chief of TalkingWithTami.com since 2007, she elevates the platform with her passion for entrepreneurship and eye-catching content on celebrities, lifestyle, and fashion.

feeds.title: MadameNoire
feeds.description: MadameNoire, a premier lifestyle website for Black women, debuted in 2010, offering daily doses of inspiration and news. Their mission is to empower women of colour with a wide-ranging content mix, spanning health, fashion, beauty, career, parenting, entertainment, and breaking news.

feeds.title: Black Girl in Maine Blog
feeds.description: Since 2008, Black Girl in Maine has been a place for articles and stories on societal, cultural, educational, and even inspirational topics. The blog page is a digital space for in-depth discussions on racism and white supremacy, a podcast series, and public talks.

feeds.title: The DAILEIGH Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Ashleigh! I'm a fashion expert and The Daileigh Blog is where I help women all over the world create a style they love. I teach women how to build a functional wardrobe, creative ways to get more wear out of their clothes, and feel more confident in their style.

feeds.title: Black Enterprise
feeds.description: Since 1970, Black Enterprise has been the go-to resource for black entrepreneurs and professionals. It offers indispensable business insights, career advice, and tech and finance content, empowering black individuals to thrive in the corporate world and beyond.

feeds.title: My Spiced Life Blog
feeds.description: My Spiced Life Blog is a Canadian Beaty/Lifestyle Blog by Jennifer, a Toronto-based Content Creator. Jennifer shares tips on Beauty, Lifestyle, Content creation, and other beautiful insights she has gained managing her life as a Content Creator and a Mother.

feeds.title: Ria Michelle Blog
feeds.description: Ria Michelle, a Miami-based style blogger and influencer, delves into fashion, food, and travel. Through her blog, she preserves cherished moments and inspires global audiences with her journey. Sharing looks, tips, and hotspots, she captivates with authenticity and creativity, aiming to inspire and connect.

feeds.title: Jamila Kyari Blog
feeds.description: JamilaKyari.com is an African fashion and lifestyle brand that inspires women to live a colourful, vibrant and bold life. It achieves this through the showcase of bright colours, vibrant prints and bold patterns in women's apparel, home decor, stationery and gifts. Content includes style posts, product reviews and lifestyle tips tricks with an African twist.

feeds.title: Young Finances
feeds.description: On this site, you will find the best financial resources for earning more money, ways to budget and save money as a recent college graduate, and how to start investing as a college student.

feeds.title: Black Girls Run Blog
feeds.description: Black Girl Run encourages and motivates African-American women to practice a healthy lifestyle and serves as a resource for all fitness levels. Their goal is to start a movement to encourage ALL women to get off the couch and get active. Their blog helps you to feel motivated as they share amazing stories, and give updates about events, healthy eating tips, and similar topics.

feeds.title: GoodTomiCha
feeds.description: Tomi Obebe, a Charlotte-based fashion and lifestyle blogger, runs GoodtoMicha.com, empowering women through style and confidence. With an MBA from Clemson University and corporate digital marketing expertise, Tomi merges business acumen with personal flair, inspiring her audience as a full-time content creator.

feeds.title: The Young Black & Fabulous
feeds.description: Young, Black and Fabulous is one of the hottest black celebrity gossip sites on the net. THE YBF blasts all that is fabulous and foolywang with millions of readers a month joining in on the ish talking. Follow to get breaking news, exclusive stories, the fab, the foolywang and instant celebrity news.

feeds.title: Kingsley Osajie
feeds.description: My blog is about Personal Development, Spirituality, Life, Motivation, Inspiration and Enlightenment.

feeds.title: I Want You To Know
feeds.description: 'I Want You To Know' unveils the world through the discerning eyes of Kristabel Plummer, a style-savvy wordsmith whose love for fashion and gastronomy transcends boundaries. With a portfolio gracing esteemed media outlets, Kristabel's blog embodies a kaleidoscope of personal reflections, travel escapades, and sartorial musings. Seamlessly blending fashion tips, wanderlust tales, and eclectic ideas, her digital haven beckons enthusiasts to explore life's vibrant tapestry of experiences and delights.

feeds.title: WhereistheBuzz
feeds.description: Founded by Wayne Ayers II in 2018, Where Is The Buzz (WTB)was created to provide a news platform for young black millennials to express themselves and get fast, reliable and relevant information. Where Is The Buzz has a passion for developing the potential of new media to transcend traditional norms. WTB has been featured in various prestigious publications including The Huffington Post, Ebony Magazine and Black Enterprise.

feeds.title: Our Nest West Blog
feeds.description: Our Nest West Blog is an online destination for millennial women who are trying to figure out this whole mommy thing without losing themselves. I'm Onteria! Here on the blog, get tips on how I'm living this wonderful thing called life and taking care of my home, my family, my finances, and most importantly - myself!

feeds.title: The African-Native American Genealogy Blog
feeds.description: A blog reflecting the lives of Blended families from African & Native American families. Read incredible yet unknown stories narrating the lives of several Oklahoma Freedmen and their collective history. It also shares updates on efforts to reclaim and restore the same African-Native American historical saga. Author Angela Y. Walton-Raji is a University administrator.

feeds.title: Therapy for Black Girls Blog
feeds.description: The Therapy for Black Girls podcast is a weekly conversation with Dr. Joy Harden Bradford, a licensed psychologist in Atlanta, Georgia, about all things mental health, personal development, and all the small decisions we can make to become the best possible version of ourselves.

feeds.title: KP FUSION
feeds.description: Kim Thomas, a Memphis-based lifestyle blogger and photographer, created KPFUSION, a fashion and lifestyle blog with a local twist. Since 2010, she has shared on-trend fashion, beauty tips, and Memphis flavour. Collaborating with brands like Macy's and hosting workshops, Kim's expertise has been featured on ABC 24 Memphis.

feeds.title: A Vibe Called Fest Blog
feeds.description: I'm Leslie, Your Festival Queen and A Vibe Called Fest is your one-stop spot for food and music events curated for Black culture! Festivals are my favorite way to travel the world. You can leave town early Friday visit a new city, hear your favorite artists, try new foods, get some pics for the 'gram, and make it to work on Monday with a big coffee and great memories. Check out the blog for a constantly updated Next Fest List and stay ahead of the curve with the FesTEAval Blog.

feeds.title: Musings with Mo
feeds.description: Musings with Mo is a a forum to share life experiences, lessons and everything related to growing and adulting well in the 21st century. It's written and curated from the perspective of Morenike (Mo), who is 'A Girl On A Mission to Becoming', and it covers faith, music, sports (mostly basketball) food, young adult and social issues.

feeds.title: Gaudy Language
feeds.description: Gaudy Language to digest all the current events at a slower pace. Whether it's about the latest news, travel, wellness, or social issues, we've got you covered.

feeds.title: Black Young Professionals Blog
feeds.description: Black Young Professionals (BYP) of Detroit is engaged in community, social, and personal development of young professionals of African descent.

feeds.title: News Moves Markets Forex » Black News
feeds.description: Latest breaking black news, including finance, economic development, politics, culture, business, and social issues impacting black communities.

feeds.title: Wealth Noir
feeds.description: I'm Damien. I'm the founder of Wealth Noir. I'm a dad, a former Facebook product manager, an MIT alum, MBA, and a self-proclaimed personal finance nerd. Wealth Noir is all about helping professional black millennials achieve financial freedom and generational wealth.

feeds.title: Honeycomb Moms Blog
feeds.description: Tips and support for black millennial moms raising thoughtful, kind and brilliant children as part of the Honeycomb Moms sisterhood.

feeds.title: Black Girl Lost Keys Blog
feeds.description: Rene Brooks after being diagnosed with ADHD 3 times, at 25 was able to get the treatment she deserved. She is the founder of Black Girl, Lost Keys, a blog that empowers black women with ADHD and shows them how to live well with the disorder. The blog covers topics like Aromatherapy, Things You Need Post ADHD Diagnosis and her podcast episodes

feeds.title: Anita Aloys Blog
feeds.description: In her Travel, Fashion, and Lifestyle Blog, Anita Aloys shares updates from her latest adventures, resources to help her followers grow their digital presence using Pinterest, and all her best tips and great finds while navigating life as a millennial woman.

feeds.title: Comfy Girl With Curls
feeds.description: Comfy Girl with Curls, led by Kaya Marriott, is a lifestyle blog centred on natural hair and personal reflections. Based in Vancouver, BC, Kaya, a Black Canadian blogger, offers support and inspiration, touching on beauty, entrepreneurship, and more. Her platform uplifts and empowers others on their journeys, fostering positivity and community.

feeds.title: Baydian Girl Blog
feeds.description: Baydian Girl is a lifestyle blog based in Columbus, OH, inspiring millennial women to live their best life via style and wellbeing content.

feeds.title: Money-Smart Millennials Blog
feeds.description: Money-Smart Millennials comes to fill a need for the millennial generation. The tips and mindset exposed in the book are not those of a Certified Public Accountant (CPA), a financial planner or financial adviser. They are simply based on the experiences of a millennial who has achieved financial stability and has helped others to do the same.

feeds.title: My Beautiful Black Ancestry
feeds.description: MBBA Global is Africa's leading platform for breaking news, historical events, culture, fashion, politics, business, entertainment, celebrity, and healthcare updates from beautiful Africans across the globe.

feeds.title: Soigne`+Swank Magazine
feeds.description: Soigne' + Swank Magazine® is a digital publication that curates black excellence in business, entertainment, lifestyle, careers, and fashion. Dedicated to honoring our ancestors and inspiring the black culture, this magazine is committed to sharing and highlighting powerful thought-provoking stories, journeys of failure to success, and empowering all things black excellence around the world. Our bi-monthly features will inspire the culture to shine at any level and transcend beyond any barrier.

feeds.title: LaRie
feeds.description: Sharing my love of home design, self improvement, quality family time, and travels around the world. Black women are multifaceted and I am here to lead by example. Through my curation of travel, home decor, lifestyle, and self-improvement content, I hope to inspire you to be excited about creating a life you love.

feeds.title: Sweet Butter Harmony
feeds.description: Finding sweetness and harmony in every day. Sometimes, as an adult, we need to carve out time to get some peace in our lives. A moment to recalibrate and refresh. This is why I created Sweet Butter Harmony. I'm constantly trying to mold what work/life balance is for me, so I can live a meaningful life. Just being a woman can be A LOT. Live isn't easy, but it shouldn't be withered by stress. We were made to thrive and live our BEST LIFE! Sweet Butter Harmony mixes all the sweet moments into a balanced life. Stories, laughs, and joys of a black female millennial.

feeds.title: Tea & Taffeta
feeds.description: My name is Kirsten, and I'm a twenty-something born and bred Baltimorean. Tea & Taffeta combines my love of tea service and classic, preppy fashion. Although Maryland is technically a southern state, its placement on the map often leaves it in a grey area where it's claimed by neither the North nor the South. So, here I am in this sweet spot with its delicious blend of cultural influences, and I'm here to show how it shapes my life and style. I'm so excited to share all that life has to offer with you, and I hope you enjoy it as much as I do!

feeds.title: The Journey With Blue
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Michelle Blue. Each week I'm interviewing a millennial who chose to challenge convention and encouraging you along your entrepreneurial 'Journey'.

feeds.title: Charlyn Asher Blog
feeds.description: Caught between two worlds, a life left in Grenada, a single black mother tells the stories of a new journey in Canada. It's a reflection of her past life in Grenada, the stories told are that of thousands of faceless black women who are now able to relate and accept who they are with pride and without shame. A personal blog about my real-life experiences, weight loss, fitness, inspiring, motivational and business. It outlines some of the highs and lows of life, with hope, hard work and belief, dreams really do come true. It's a journey from extreme poverty to a life full of prosperity.

feeds.title: Blavity Bulletin
feeds.description: Blavity is a tech company for forward thinking Black millennials pushing the boundaries of culture and the status quo.

feeds.title: Nefer Kali Healing Blog
feeds.description: Journey into the mystical realms of Astrology, Ayurvedic medicine, and Holistic life with the Nefer Kali Healing Blog. Our business offers holistic health solutions through Ayurveda, Jyotish, and Qigong practices, providing tinctures, consultations, and classes.

feeds.title: Bossip
feeds.description: Bossip.com is the premier destination for African American popular culture and entertainment, with a voice that's edgy, viciously hilarious, politically aware and completely unique. Bossip draws a loyal following of young and influential trendsetters who are up to date with what's hot in society and have been most recently mentioned by many top news outlets.

feeds.title: L'Homme Noir
feeds.description: L'Homme Noir was created as the black man's guide to navigating the 21st century without having to subscribe to the 'what's left', low quality, low value content being offered to men in general and specifically to those of colour.

feeds.title: Hey Crystallace
feeds.description: Hey there! I'm a lawyer and a blogger that wanted to help other entrepreneurs by providing low cost DIY Legal Solutions. I have spent the time doing the legal research and the drafting to create these simple, easy-to-use, legal templates.

feeds.title: Balanced Black Girl Blog
feeds.description: Balanced Black Girl is here to build a mindful collective that puts the needs of Black women first. They do this by creating free and accessible wellness content and resources, amplifying the voices of Black and brown women in wellness, and shining a light on healers and practitioners making waves in our community. Read interesting articles on their blog such as daily habits for a better life, podcast to hear, affirmation to hear, setting boundaries, and more,

feeds.title: BYP Network Blog
feeds.description: BYP Network is a community for black young professionals to connect for networking and job opportunities.

feeds.title: NOIR ONLINE
feeds.description: Providing a safe space for Black millennials while covering trending and community news, fashion and beauty updates paired with Black excellency and culture.

feeds.title: Blogging Black Miami
feeds.description: Blogging Black Miami by Va-Va Byers offers an overview of South Florida's cultural landscape from an African-American Blogger's perspective. Read sharp, invigorative, opinion pieces that provide and amplify the African-American voices, culture, and lives throughout society today.

feeds.title: Angel 2 Angel Blog
feeds.description: Catch all the latest Programs, Seminar, and Workshop details from Angel 2 Angel in this blog. Angel 2 Angel is a non-profit community organization that offers programs on Mental Health/Women Transitioning, Education, and Financial Literacy to contribute towards a positive change in society.
